note: New Zealand issues no national identity card: the Department of Internal Affairs' material on the Digital Identity Services Trust Framework, released under the Official Information Act, says New Zealand does not have, and is not planning to create, a single national ID. Other cards, as the driver licence, are left to the New Zealand package.

sources.title: Department of Internal Affairs, OIA 2526-1378, Appendix A (as published by the Free Speech Union)
sources.said: New Zealand does not have, and is not planning to create, a single national ID, digital ID or unique
